name: v2.0.0
body:
## What's Changed
* 2.0.0 by @wieluk in https://github.com/wieluk/psychopy_linux_installer/pull/71
  * Use `uv` to manage both Python versions and virtual environments
  * Support Python >= 3.8 (drop the previous `< 3.11` upper bound, since `uv` doesn't enforce it)
  * Add an uninstaller for the startup script
  * Introduce `--wxpython-wheel-index=URL` for specifying a custom wheel repository
  * Add `--no-fonts` flag to skip font installation via the package manager
  * Fallback to a local `PATH` entry if the global one isn't writable
  * Restructure the installation script

* Prevent the GID to become 1000 in live builds. by @dev-jam in https://github.com/wieluk/psychopy_linux_installer/pull/72

## New Contributors
* @dev-jam made their first contribution in https://github.com/wieluk/psychopy_linux_installer/pull/72

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/wieluk/psychopy_linux_installer/compare/v1.7.2...v2.0.0

* Added --version flag

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/wieluk/psychopy_linux_installer/compare/v1.6.0...v1.6.1

name: v1.6.0
body:
## What's Changed

**Installation Improvements**
- Changed the default PsychoPy install directory to `/usr/local/psychopy`
- Added a symlink to the PsychoPy launcher in `/usr/local/bin` ([#62](https://github.com/wieluk/psychopy_linux_installer/pull/62))
- Python altinstall is now placed in `/usr/local/psychopy/python`, and wxPython wheels in `/usr/local/psychopy/python/wx_wheels` (previously both were under `/usr/local/psychopy_python`)
- Set permissions automatically for installation directories
- Sanitized installation path to handle `~` and trailing slashes
- Refactored package installation logic for clearer logging and better handling of already-installed packages
- Added missing `wxPython` build dependencies (`pkg-config` / `pkgconf`)

**User Settings**
- Added an option to remove existing PsychoPy user settings during installation using the `--remove-psychopy-settings` flag ([#60](https://github.com/wieluk/psychopy_linux_installer/pull/60))

**Full Changelog**: [v1.5.4...v1.6.0](https://github.com/wieluk/psychopy_linux_installer/compare/v1.5.4...v1.6.0)
